notes.title: Brain Bait will become a free game from June 7th onward
notes.notes:
Hello Zombie Trappers,

Starting June 7h Brain Bait will be free to download for everyone, forever. (Or at least until Steam shuts down ^^)
If you had already purchased the game beforehand you will of course just keep it in your library.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Day-1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello there!

I've just released a small patch with the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added option to restart a level
[*] Mouse cursor hidden during gameplay
[*] Added security question before saying "no" to a continue or restarting
[*] Fixed some minor collision issues
[*] Increased three star time for level 3
[/list]
